STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_057846.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_057846.v · Open raw
module origen_057846 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire sclk,
    input wire din,
    input wire load_en,
    input wire [15:0] dout_word,
    output reg lclk,
    output reg [7:0] din_word,
    output wire dout,
    output reg done,
    output reg [3:0] aux
);

    reg [7:0] reg_in;
    reg [15:0] reg_out;
    reg [3:0] in_state;
    reg [4:0] out_state;
    reg dout_en;

    // Input state machine
    always @(posedge sclk) begin
        if (in_state == 8) begin
            in_state <= 1;
            din_word <= reg_in;
        end else begin
            in_state <= in_state + 1;
            reg_in <= {reg_in[6:0], din};
        end
    end

    // Output state machine
    always @(negedge sclk) begin
        if (out_state == 15) begin
            out_state <= 0;
        end else begin
            out_state <= out_state + 1;
        end
        
        if (load_en) begin
            reg_out <= dout_word;
        end else begin
            reg_out <= {reg_out[14:0], 1'b0};
        end
        
        dout_en <= (out_state != 0);
    end

    // Control signals
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        lclk <= (in_state == 8);
        done <= (in_state == 0 || in_state == 8);
        aux <= in_state;
    end

    // Output assignment
    assign dout = dout_en ? reg_out[15] : 1'bz;

endmodule
